changelog:
## 1.6

- Refreshed the screenshots and store description.

## 1.5

- Russian language: the whole app plus all 36 labs and quizzes are translated.
  Choose the language in Settings.
- Every lab now has its own unique badge icon.
- Quizzes reward XP now (per correct answer); total XP is capped at 9999.
- Long lab and quiz titles scroll so you can read them in full.
- The XP counter goes glitchy once you max it out.
- Profile screen and several labels realigned for a cleaner fit; About screen
  polish.

## 1.4

- Settings now has independent LED and Vibro toggles (both default on), next to
  the Sound toggle - turn light or vibration off globally on their own.
- The About screen shows the correct app version.

## 1.3

- 6 advanced labs with deeper per-subsystem topics and extra quizzes: MIFARE
  Keys (MFKey32, nested attacks), T5577 cloning, IR protocols, iButton cloning,
  advanced Bad USB payloads, and logic/bus sniffing. Now 36 labs.
- Selected home tiles use a calm breathing cursor; Quiz and Labs navigation
  clicks softly.
- Fixed the Bluetooth glyph to match the real logo.

## 1.2.1

- Home screen scroll hints are back at the top and bottom as small chevrons.

## 1.2

- Level Up screen now rains confetti and lingers 50% longer to enjoy it.
- Each achievement badge plays its own unique jingle when you press OK on it.
- Scrolling the badge gallery clicks like flipping through metal coins.
- Reworked About: a matrix-rain intro, a self-typing terminal with soft
  printing clicks, and a coffee-break page with a donation QR code.
- Home screen is now a 2x2 tile grid with icons instead of a plain list.
- Level Up plays a richer, more triumphant fanfare.
- About coffee page: a Pac-Man endlessly munching coffee cups above the QR.
- Resetting progress now plays a short "cleared" flash with a wipe sound.
- Wrong quiz answers shake the feedback; a lighter chime marks a finished step.
- Home tiles click like coins as you move between them.
- New Quiz mode: a random exam drawn from the quizzes of your completed labs,
  with a score at the end. Home menu is now a 5-tile grid.

## 1.1

- About screen now links to github.com/PerfectoWeb.
- Presentable README with a theme-aware banner and a screenshot gallery.

## 1.0

First public release: 11 labs across the popular Flipper features, randomized and
shuffled quizzes, XP with levels and badges saved on the SD card, per-topic
glyphs, sound and LED feedback, and a terminal-style About screen.
description:
# PocketLab

The missing onboarding layer for Flipper Zero. Short, gamified, on-device labs
teach your Flipper's own features step by step, then reward you with XP, levels
and badges - a guided, legal and genuinely fun way to learn what your device can
do, one small lab at a time.

## Features

- **36 labs** across 11 tracks: IR, Sub-GHz, 125 kHz RFID, NFC, iButton, Bad USB,
  GPIO/UART, Bluetooth, security, system and more - including advanced deep-dives
  (MIFARE key recovery / MFKey32, T5577 cloning, IR protocols and more).
- **English and Russian** - the full interface plus every lab and quiz, with a
  language switch in Settings.
- **Randomized quizzes** - a pool of distractors, shuffled every attempt, so you
  learn the answer, not its position.
- **Quiz mode** - a random exam drawn from the labs you've completed, scored at
  the end and rewarding XP.
- **Progression** - XP, levels, a daily streak and unlockable badges, saved on
  the SD card.
- **A unique badge icon for every lab**, so the subject reads at a glance.
- **Custom animated UI** - a tile menu, a badge gallery, stat cards and an
  animated About screen.
- **Sound, LED and Vibro** feedback, each with its own toggle in Settings.
- **No extra hardware** - pure software, runs on a stock Flipper Zero.

## How to use

Open **Apps -> Tools -> PocketLab**, pick **Labs**, and work through one. Each lab
ends with a hands-on step that points you to the real built-in app, so you learn
by doing. Test yourself any time with **Quiz**. Use it only on your own devices.
